updates.text: Norwell carried the ACE combination with Brewster to the linebacker and recovered after losing initial leverage once to Miller in protection. He handled calls from both guards. The changed arrangement was an evaluation opportunity; no starting point changed.
updates.source: Source: [dated camp observations](career/2014/Training_Camp_and_Preseason/Training_Camp/training_report.md). This coaching update preserves the opening grades above.

short.text: Andrew Norwell signed with Jacksonville as an undrafted rookie in 2014, competed for the left guard job and made the opening roster as the reserve guard. He has been active for {{2014.regular.games:words}} regular-season games and has played {{2014.regular.offensive_snaps:words}} offensive snaps. A three-year college starter at guard, he has a strong upper body and finishes blocks physically, and in camp he carried a combination block to the linebacker and recovered after losing leverage in protection. He is a limited athlete, short on speed and lateral movement.

transactions.text: Signed a three-year contract with Jacksonville as an undrafted rookie
